result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it applies on any expiry or termination, provides up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, requires data return in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days of request, and requires subsequent deletion certification. The change is narrowly confined to the new transition provision and its survival reference, without disturbing the existing termination rights. Drafting is generally professional, though quality would improve by using any defined term for Customer Data and by anchoring the 30-day export period directly to expiry or termination rather than to Sparkling’s request.
